replies.text: ​@tenton459That is exactly what Eminent domain means. Taking what is not yours. Just on a bigger scale.  At least in this case the indigenous people were relocated instead of killed.  The world is a dangerous place. Unthinkable things are done every day in the name of security.  Russia invaded all of eastern Europe to create the Soviet Union in the name of State security. They killed millions of people. Relocating a relatively small amount of people off of a strategically located island is just another one of those things countries do to monitor their enemies and provide forward staging bases in which to respond to threats. It is happening in Greenland right now. This unfortunately is the world we live in.
